description: Circuit breaker activates after 5 consecutive discovery source fetch failures and auto-recovers after a configurable cooldown period (default 1 hour).

preconditions.description: Discovery polling is active and encountering failures

expectedOutcome.description: After 5 consecutive failures, isOpen transitions to true. After cooldown expires, isCircuitBreakerAllowing returns true. Any success resets consecutiveFailures to 0.
